MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like a natural next choice for me right now.",
    "The nuts, tape, and epoxy loosely fit my recent interest in fastening and maintenance, but that connection alone did not give me a reason to choose them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Nuts and metal-cutting wheels do not serve the same tasks as the framing nails and wood screws I recently chose.",
    "The valves, pipe fittings, hose adapter, thermometer, and safety can require specific tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape and twelve wastebaskets are more than I currently need; my vacuum-bag purchase was for a replacement consumable, not new waste containers.",
    "Epoxy might be useful someday, but I have no current repair that calls for it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular fastening supplies seems to have been treated as interest in almost any hardware or workshop supply.",
    "My household-maintenance purchases seem to have been stretched into a need for unrelated repair and cleaning products.",
    "My purchases of packaged fasteners seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest large quantities of other supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The strongest repeated pattern in my recent choices is framing nails, wood screws, and wall anchors, where the fastening task and exact specifications matter.",
    "I need a concrete use for an item now, especially when it requires a particular connection, tool, or repair.",
    "Quantity matters for each product separately; needing many screws does not mean I need many rolls of tape or wastebaskets.",
    "Replacement vacuum bags need to fit the vacuum, so that purchase says more about compatibility than a broad interest in cleaning equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad maintenance theme but missed my specific fastening tasks, compatibility needs, and current quantities."
}
